subject: mathematics
concept: Classifying triangles by side length (equilateral, isosceles, scalene)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student measures the sides of virtual triangle tiles with a tool and sorts them by type
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts pictured triangles into equilateral, isosceles, or scalene groups
exercise.abstract: Student classifies a triangle from given side lengths

misconception_flags: confuses isosceles (two equal sides) with equilateral (three equal sides)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
